study type: Secondary analysis of baseline data from a quasi-experimental study (cross-sectional)
outcome: Maternal awareness of newborn danger signs (NDS)
cohort: The study enrolled 250 post-natal women from a Tertiary Care and Teaching Hospital in Eastern Uganda.
finding: Maternal awareness of newborn danger signs in the immediate post-delivery period was poor, with only 14.0% of participants having good awareness.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with maternal awareness of newborn danger signs.
cross-section timing: Immediately after delivery, before discharge from the hospital
